q.en: Fix: "Because it was raining. We stayed inside."
q.bn: ঠিক করো: "Because it was raining. We stayed inside."

options.en: Because it was raining, we stayed inside.
options.bn: Because it was raining, we stayed inside.

options.en: Because it was raining we stayed, inside.
options.bn: Because it was raining we stayed, inside.

options.en: Because, it was raining. We stayed inside.
options.bn: Because, it was raining. We stayed inside.

options.en: Because it was raining. We, stayed inside.
options.bn: Because it was raining. We, stayed inside.

why.en: "Because it was raining" is a dependent clause (a fragment) — it must be joined to the independent clause with a comma, not left as its own sentence.
why.bn: "Because it was raining" একটা dependent clause (fragment) — এটা comma দিয়ে independent clause-এর সাথে জোড়া দিতে হবে, আলাদা sentence রাখা যাবে না।

q.en: Fix the comma splice: "It was raining, we stayed inside."
q.bn: Comma splice ঠিক করো: "It was raining, we stayed inside."

options.en: It was raining we stayed inside.
options.bn: It was raining we stayed inside.

options.en: It was raining, so we stayed inside.
options.bn: It was raining, so we stayed inside.

options.en: It was raining, we, stayed inside.
options.bn: It was raining, we, stayed inside.

options.en: It, was raining, we stayed inside.
options.bn: It, was raining, we stayed inside.

why.en: A comma alone can't join two independent clauses — add a conjunction like "so", or use a period/semicolon instead.
why.bn: শুধু comma দিয়ে দুটো independent clause জোড়া দেওয়া যায় না — "so"-এর মতো conjunction যুক্ত করো, বা period/semicolon ব্যবহার করো।

q.en: Does this need a comma: "We stayed inside because it was raining"?
q.bn: এটার কি comma লাগবে: "We stayed inside because it was raining"?

options.en: Yes, always.
options.bn: হ্যাঁ, সবসময়।

options.en: No — the independent clause comes first.
options.bn: না — independent clause আগে আছে।

options.en: Only in formal writing.
options.bn: শুধু formal writing-এ।

options.en: Yes, but only before "inside".
options.bn: হ্যাঁ, কিন্তু শুধু "inside"-এর আগে।

why.en: When the independent clause comes first and the dependent clause follows, a comma usually isn't needed.
why.bn: Independent clause আগে থাকলে এবং dependent clause পরে আসলে, সাধারণত comma লাগে না।

q.en: Is "Although the exam was difficult" a fragment or a complete sentence?
q.bn: "Although the exam was difficult" — এটা fragment না কি complete sentence?

options.en: A complete sentence.
options.bn: একটা complete sentence।

options.en: A fragment — it needs a main clause attached.
options.bn: একটা fragment — এর সাথে main clause লাগানো লাগবে।

options.en: A comma splice.
options.bn: একটা comma splice।

options.en: A run-on sentence.
options.bn: একটা run-on sentence।

why.en: "Although" makes this a dependent clause — it can't stand alone and needs an independent clause attached, e.g. "...I passed."
why.bn: "Although" এটাকে dependent clause বানায় — এটা একা দাঁড়াতে পারে না, এর সাথে independent clause লাগাতে হয়, যেমন "...I passed."

options.en: It was raining, so we stayed inside.
options.bn: It was raining, so we stayed inside.

options.en: It was raining we stayed inside.
options.bn: It was raining we stayed inside.

options.en: Because it was raining, we stayed inside.

options.en: It was raining; we stayed inside.
options.bn: It was raining; we stayed inside.

why.en: A run-on joins two independent clauses with no punctuation at all between them.
why.bn: Run-on sentence দুটো independent clause-এর মাঝে কোনো punctuation ছাড়াই জোড়া দেয়।
